# ARTIFACT B: re-verify per-position conservation across vertebrate SLC3A1 orthologs, and plot the three summary panels
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
BL="""ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV
A 4-1-2-2 0-1-1 0-2-1-1-1-1-2-1 1 0-3-2 0
R-1 5 0-2-3 1 0-2 0-3-2 2-1-3-2-1-1-3-2-3
N-2 0 6 1-3 0 0 0 1-3-3 0-2-3-2 1 0-4-2-3
D-2-2 1 6-3 0 2-1-1-3-4-1-3-3-1 0-1-4-3-3
C 0-3-3-3 9-3-4-3-3-1-1-3-1-2-3-1-1-2-2-1
Q-1 1 0 0-3 5 2-2 0-3-2 1 0-3-1 0-1-2-1-2
E-1 0 0 2-4 2 5-2 0-3-3 1-2-3-1 0-1-3-2-2
G 0-2 0-1-3-2-2 6-2-4-4-2-3-3-2 0-2-2-3-3
H-2 0 1-1-3 0 0-2 8-3-3-1-2-1-2-1-2-2 2-3
I-1-3-3-3-1-3-3-4-3 4 2-3 1 0-3-2-1-3-1 3
L-1-2-3-4-1-2-3-4-3 2 4-2 2 0-3-2-1-2-1 1
K-1 2 0-1-3 1 1-2-1-3-2 5-1-3-1 0-1-3-2-2
M-1-1-2-3-1 0-2-3-2 1 2-1 5 0-2-1-1-1-1 1
F-2-3-3-3-2-3-3-3-1 0 0-3 0 6-4-2-2 1 3-1
P-1-2-2-1-3-1-1-2-2-3-3-1-2-4 7-1-1-4-3-2
S 1-1 1 0-1 0 0 0-1-2-2 0-1-2-1 4 1-3-2-2
T 0-1 0-1-1-1-1-2-2-1-1-1-1-2-1 1 5-2-2 0
W-3-3-4-4-2-2-3-2-2-3-2-3-1 1-4-3-2 11 2-3
Y-2-2-2-3-2-1-2-3 2-1-1-2-1 3-3-2-2 2 7-1
V 0-3-3-3-1-2-2-3-3 3 1-2 1-1-2-2 0-3-1 4"""
rows=BL.split('\n'); AAs=rows[0].strip(); SC={}
for ln in rows[1:]:
    v=[int(x) for x in re.findall(r'-?\d+',ln[1:])]; assert len(v)==20; SC[ln[0]]=dict(zip(AAs,v))
for a in list(SC): SC[a]['X']=-1
SC['X']={b:-1 for b in AAs}; SC['X']['X']=-1
def bnw(a,b,band=50,go=-11,ge=-1):
    NEG=-10**9; n,m=len(a),len(b); pM={}; tb=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        c=int(round(i*m/n)); lo=max(1,c-band); hi=min(m,c+band)
        Sa=SC.get(a[i-1],SC['X']); M={}; row={}; lastX=NEG
        for j in range(lo,hi+1):
            dm=(0 if i==1 else pM.get(j-1,NEG))+Sa.get(b[j-1],-1)
            up=pM.get(j,NEG)+go; lf=max(M.get(j-1,NEG)+go,lastX+ge); lastX=lf
            best=dm; code=1
            if up>best: best,code=up,2
            if lf>best: best,code=lf,3
            M[j]=best; row[j]=code
        tb.append(row); pM=M
    j=max(pM,key=pM.get); i=n; pr={}
    while i>0 and j>0:
        c=tb[i-1].get(j)
        if c is None: break
        if c==1: pr[i]=j; i-=1; j-=1
        elif c==2: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr
def fasta(t):
    o={}; k=None
    for ln in t.split('\n'):
        if ln.startswith('>'): k=ln[1:].split()[0]; o[k]=''
        elif k: o[k]+=ln.strip()
    return o
hum=list(fasta(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q07837.fasta",timeout=60).text).values())[0]
orth=fasta(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params={"query":"(gene:SLC3A1) AND (taxonomy_id:7742)","format":"fasta","includeIsoform":"false"},timeout=240).text)
orth={k:v for k,v in orth.items() if 400<len(v)<900 and 'Q07837' not in k}
match=np.zeros(len(hum)); tot=0; aa_at={p:{} for p in [210,215,312,314,384,448,449,174,214,321,114]}
for k,s in orth.items():
    pr=bnw(hum,s); tot+=1
    for i,j in pr.items():
        if s[j-1]==hum[i-1]: match[i-1]+=1
    for p in aa_at:
        if p in pr: aa_at[p][s[pr[p]-1]]=aa_at[p].get(s[pr[p]-1],0)+1
cons=100*match/tot
print(f"orthologs n={tot}; mean per-position identity {cons.mean():.1f}%")
POS=[(210,'D210 CSR-I Asp','retained'),(215,'H215 CSR-I His','retained'),(312,'S312 (was CSR-II Arg)','LOST'),
     (314,'D314 nucleophile','retained'),(384,'E384 acid/base','retained'),(448,'P448 (was CSR-IV His)','LOST'),
     (449,'D449 TS-stabiliser','retained'),(174,'R174 plugs subsite -1','blocker'),
     (214,'N214 Ca2+ ligand','Ca2+'),(321,'E321 Ca2+ ligand','Ca2+'),(114,'C114 disulfide','interface')]
T=pd.DataFrame([{'pos':p,'label':l,'status':st,'human_aa':hum[p-1],'cons_pct':round(float(cons[p-1]),1),
                 'top_alternatives':', '.join(f"{a}:{n}" for a,n in sorted(aa_at[p].items(),key=lambda x:-x[1])[:4])}
                for p,l,st in POS])
print("\n=== PER-POSITION CONSERVATION ACROSS VERTEBRATE SLC3A1 ORTHOLOGS ===")
print(T.to_string(index=False))
print("\n---CONSERVATION_CSV---\n"+T.to_csv(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
colmap={'retained':'#27ae60','LOST':'#c0392b','blocker':'#e67e22','Ca2+':'#f1c40f','interface':'#2980b9'}
ax[0].bar(range(len(T)),T.cons_pct,color=[colmap[s] for s in T.status])
ax[0].axhline(cons.mean(),ls='--',c='k',lw=1)
ax[0].text(len(T)-0.4,cons.mean()+2,f"protein mean {cons.mean():.1f}%",ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(T))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(T.human_aa+T.pos.astype(str),rotation=45,fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel(f'identity across {tot} vertebrate orthologs (%)'); ax[0].set_ylim(0,108)
ax[0].set_title('Ca2+ ligands, the disulfide and the structural CSR-I pair are\ninvariant; the catalytic carboxylates are not',fontsize=9)
for i,s in enumerate(T.status):
    if s in ('retained','LOST'): ax[0].text(i,T.cons_pct[i]+2,'keep' if s=='retained' else 'lost',ha='center',fontsize=6,color=colmap[s])
lbl=['CSR-I\nD98','CSR-I His\nH103','CSR-II Arg\nR197','nucleophile\nD199','acid/base\nE255','CSR-IV His\nH328','TS-stab\nD329']
rb=[1,1,0,1,1,0,1]; f2v=[0]*7
ax[1].bar(np.arange(7)-0.2,rb,0.4,color='#27ae60',label='rBAT / SLC3A1 (5 of 7)')
ax[1].bar(np.arange(7)+0.2,f2v,0.4,color='#7f8c8d',label='4F2hc / SLC3A2 (0 of 7)')
ax[1].set_xticks(range(7)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(lbl,fontsize=7); ax[1].set_yticks([0,1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels(['lost','retained'])
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc='center right'); ax[1].set_ylim(0,1.3)
ax[1].set_title('GH13 functional positions after 3D superposition onto\noligo-1,6-glucosidase 1UOK (rBAT 459 CA, 1.68 A; 4F2hc 200 CA, 2.54 A)',fontsize=9)
for i,(v,t_) in enumerate(zip(rb,['D210','H215','S312','D314','E384','P448','D449'])):
    ax[1].text(i-0.2,v+0.04,t_,ha='center',fontsize=7,color='#27ae60' if v else '#c0392b')
for i,t_ in enumerate(['A277','N215','I287','T279','S282','S333','L334']):
    ax[1].text(i+0.2,0.04,t_,ha='center',fontsize=7,color='#7f8c8d')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
